resume: Childcare places are scarce in Mayotte: where to look, which documents to prepare, and how to get the complément de libre choix du mode de garde (CMG, childcare allowance) paid by the CSSM (Caisse de sécurité sociale de Mayotte, Mayotte's social security fund).
aQuoiCaSert: Having your young child looked after lets you work or train. In Mayotte, daycare (crèche) places are few: you need to start very early. If you employ a registered childminder (assistante maternelle agréée) or a home childcare worker, or if the child attends an eligible daycare or micro-daycare (micro-crèche), the CSSM can pay the complément de libre choix du mode de garde (CMG) and cover all or part of the social security contributions.
quiEstConcerne: Parents of a child aged 6 or under (under 12 for a single-parent family), for the CMG.
Separated parents with shared residence: each can receive the CMG since December 2025.
aSavoir: The CMG exists in Mayotte. Since September 1, 2025, its amount no longer depends on flat rates by bracket: it is calculated according to your monthly resources, the family's composition, the hourly cost and the number of hours of childcare.
It covers a childminder, home childcare, a daycare or a micro-daycare, depending on the case (CSSM).
Direct employer of a childminder or home childcare worker: declare the pay every month on pajemploi.urssaf.fr.

Childminders must be registered (agréées) by the PMI (protection maternelle et infantile, the mother and child health service) of the Département de Mayotte (local council). You become their employer and sign an employment contract.
Public daycare: the application form is usually picked up at the town hall (mairie). Non-profit or private daycare: you register with the management.

documents.detail: Copy. Compulsory vaccines are required to start in a group setting.

documents.detail: Signed original. Ask for a copy of the registration issued by the PMI.
